inv.desc_en:
COMMERCIAL PREMISES FOR RENT IN TRIANA - PLAZA DE SANTA ANA AREA - 145M2. -

INMO APGESTION offers this corner commercial space in Triana, a high-traffic area, a hospitality zone, and next to the Santa Ana church. -

145m2, large display windows, high ceilings, security shutters, 2 bathrooms. -

Previously a grocery store/delicatessen; possibility for hospitality use but without a smoke vent, outdoor seating available. -

Also suitable for other types of businesses adapted to the location; being a corner unit offers many possibilities. -

Rent: €3,000 (agency fee: one month's rent + VAT). -

Do not hesitate to contact us. - Immediate availability. -
Oscar. -6.6. 5.2. 0.5. 3.1. 9. -.
